resources.string: Your cycle. Your connection. Your data.
Your entries stay on your own server and are shared only according to your choices.
Lunara is not a medical device or a contraceptive. Predictions are estimates.

Enter the regular HTTPS address. If the server provides a dedicated header-auth address, you may enter https://user:app-password@your-server.example once. Lunara then separates and encrypts those credentials.
Allow insecure HTTP in local development mode
HTTP sends data without encryption and may only be used in a trusted development environment.
Changing servers permanently erases all local cycle data, pending changes, credentials, and server sessions on this device. Entries that have not synced will be lost.
Hold the complete server QR code straight inside the frame.

Hold the complete invitation QR code straight inside the frame.

Set up Lunara for the first time
Only for the very first tracker account on a completely empty server. The token is available only in the local server configuration. Afterwards, access uses sign-in or an invitation.
Confirm your secure Authentik access once before redeeming the invitation. You can then redeem the invitation code directly in Lunara.
If your server uses Authentik in front of Lunara, confirm secure access once before redeeming the invitation.
Authentik is confirmed. You can now scan the invitation QR code and finish connecting securely.
Your Authentik account is your Lunara sign-in. No additional username or second password is required here.
Scan the personal invitation first, then sign in with Authentik. The QR code only grants the approved partner role to your Authentik account; no second account is created.

Enter a valid start date today or in the past using YYYY-MM-DD.
Enter a valid end date today or in the past, or leave the field blank.
The end date cannot be before the start date.
Leave blank while the period is still ongoing.
The start and optional end are stored as local calendar dates. Blank means the period is still ongoing.
Correct the start and end, or leave the end date blank for an ongoing period.
The first day is selected. Now tap the final period day — for example, tap 18 and then 22.
The current range is selected. Tap “Select again” to choose a new start and end. For an ongoing period, you can tap the end date directly.
Now tap the final period day. You can tap the same day.

Your local entries are kept. Sign in again with the same account; pending entries will upload automatically afterward. You do not need to sign out.
Renew sign-in for %1$s using your existing account. Your partner connection and sharing settings stay unchanged.
If you sign in with a Lunara password, use your own existing username and password.
Sign in again with Lunara password
Complete sign-in in your browser. If it was cancelled, close this dialog and try again.

Sign-in was not renewed. Check your credentials and connection, then try again. Your local entries and pending changes are kept.

%1$d changes have a synchronization conflict. Your local version is kept until you decide.
This explicitly uses the server version for affected entries. Unsynced local changes to those entries will be discarded. Other local data remains unchanged.

Swipe sideways between months. Tap the first period day, then select the final day. Tap an existing range to change it.

Ask first, then act. Suggestions only use information that was explicitly shared.
Blocks screenshots and previews in the recent apps screen.
Changes your personal Lunara password and revokes every other Lunara server session.
This means your personal Lunara password. Other Lunara server sessions are revoked. Data already stored offline remains on those devices.
The new password must be 8–128 characters long. Uppercase letters, numbers, and special characters are not required.
The new password must differ from the current password.
The two new-password entries do not match.
The current Lunara password is incorrect.
The password could not be changed. Check the connection and try again.
Password changed. Every other Lunara server session was revoked.
Shown only after at least three complete cycles and disabled in special modes.
Enable the optional fertility estimate first. Without it, no fertility data is calculated or shared.
Lunara calculates an uncertain range from past calendar data only. It does not detect ovulation, establish pregnancy, and must never be used for contraception.
Create a single-use invitation code. It remains valid until it is used or you revoke it and contains neither a password nor server credentials.
Valid until it is used or you revoke the invitation.
An invitation is active. For security, its code is shown only immediately after creation.
QR code for invitation %1$s. It opens the secure invitation page on this server.
Only confirm an invitation intended for you. Your empty account will then be connected as a partner account.
Tips may consider explicitly shared symptoms without revealing private details in the tip text.
Enable “Share symptoms” first. Symptoms that are not shared must never influence tips.
By default, Partner B only sees the estimated range. More information becomes visible only after an explicit choice.
These personal preferences guide respectful partner tips. They do not share any additional health data.

Username: 3–64 characters with no spaces. It must start with a letter or number; dots, underscores and hyphens are also allowed.
The new Lunara password must be 8–128 characters long. Uppercase letters, numbers, and special characters are not required.
The bootstrap token must be 20–256 characters long. Copy only its value, without “BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN=” or quotation marks.
The server did not accept the bootstrap token. Copy only its value from the local server file, without “BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN=” or quotation marks.

No account and no server. Your health data stays encrypted on this device; partner connection is not available in this mode.
Use period tracking, daily logs, calendar, history and local reminders on your own.
No server account, cloud or network sync. Protect your device and create an encrypted portable backup regularly.
Periods and daily logs exist only in Lunara’s encrypted database on this device. No health data is sent to a server.

All local periods, daily logs, settings and keys will be erased permanently. You can then connect a server.
Transfer local data through a file you choose, such as Google Drive, Nextcloud or USB. Lunara uses AES-256-GCM and never stores the passphrase.
Use at least 12 characters. The backup cannot be restored without this passphrase.
The file is encrypted independently of Android Keystore and can be transferred to a new phone. Keep the passphrase separate and safe.
Validated data from this backup replaces all current local periods, daily logs and included settings on this device.
Incorrect passphrase or modified file. No data was imported.

Local reminders are scheduled on this device after synchronization.

Reminds you when the roughly estimated fertile window starts tomorrow. Not a contraceptive method.
Reminds you once at the chosen time if no entry has been added today.
Notifies you at most once per day when an approved partner tip is available.

Only a neutral Lunara notice appears on the lock screen.
